dry-run.effect_identity: repository identity plus branch plus remote-url hash plus source HEAD plus manifest and worktree-content hashes
dry-run.reconciliation: Replay the exact preflight; return a typed eligibility report and perform no staging, commit, fetch, rebase, or push.

integrate-remote-and-resume.effect_identity: authorization receipt id plus original effect commit plus fetched remote head plus merge base plus manifest hash
integrate-remote-and-resume.prepare: Persist the fetched remote head, merge base, authorized scope, original commit identity, and pre-rebase repository snapshot before rebase.
integrate-remote-and-resume.reconciliation: Use Git rebase state plus effect trailer, parent lineage, exact manifest delta, and remote head. A completed exact integrated commit is ALREADY_APPLIED; fully restored original state is NOT_APPLIED; partial/conflicting rebase or scope drift is INDETERMINATE and must fail closed.

isolated-integrate-and-resume.effect_identity: authorization receipt id plus source commit/state hash plus fetched remote head plus manifest/overlay/message hashes
isolated-integrate-and-resume.prepare: Persist source snapshot, remote snapshot, deterministic isolated commit metadata, and temporary-workspace identity before cloning.
isolated-integrate-and-resume.reconciliation: Query the remote for the exact effect trailer and authorized tree delta. A matching remote head with unchanged source is ALREADY_APPLIED; unchanged remote/source with no effect commit is NOT_APPLIED; remote advance, conflicting effect marker, or changed source is INDETERMINATE.

isolated-reconcile-and-resume.effect_identity: authorization receipt id plus source commit/state hash plus fetched remote head/merge base plus manifest/overlay hashes plus canonical ledger event-id set hash
isolated-reconcile-and-resume.prepare: Persist source and remote snapshots, approved semantic paths, canonical ledger identities, and deterministic isolated commit metadata before reconciliation.
isolated-reconcile-and-resume.reconciliation: Require the exact effect-marked remote commit, authorized tree delta, canonical ledger union, regenerated blocker view, and byte-identical source snapshot for ALREADY_APPLIED. Unchanged remote/source with no effect commit is NOT_APPLIED; any semantic, remote, or source disagreement is INDETERMINATE.

publish.effect_identity: authorization receipt id plus repository identity plus initial HEAD plus branch plus remote-url hash plus manifest/content hash plus approved message hash
publish.local_reconciliation: If HEAD is the prepared initial HEAD and the index is empty, the local mutation is NOT_APPLIED. If HEAD is one direct child carrying the exact Prevention-Effect-ID trailer, approved message, parent, author/committer policy, and manifest-only tree delta, it is ALREADY_APPLIED_LOCAL. Any other HEAD/index/scope state is INDETERMINATE.
publish.prepare: Persist all identity fields, source/index/worktree snapshots, deterministic effect trailer, and authorization consumption before git add.
publish.remote_reconciliation: Resolve the remote branch head. Exact equality to the identified local effect commit is ALREADY_APPLIED_REMOTE; the prepared prior remote head with local effect commit retained is NOT_APPLIED_REMOTE; remote advance, missing effect commit, or conflicting effect marker is INDETERMINATE.

resume-push.effect_identity: authorization receipt id plus repository identity plus exact effect-marked HEAD commit plus branch and remote-url hash
resume-push.reconciliation: Require the exact prepared effect commit at HEAD, empty index, and unchanged authorized identities; reconcile the remote branch exactly as publish without creating another commit.

policy.resume_rule: Continue only the first NOT_APPLIED stage. Never create a second effect-marked commit or push after ALREADY_APPLIED_REMOTE; every INDETERMINATE state stops without force push, reset, stash, or destructive cleanup.

common: The process return code is zero.

The schema-valid terminal artifact has ok=true and names mode, effect_id, authorization receipt id when required, repository identity, branch, remote-url hash, manifests, source/commit/remote object ids, and observation codes.
The semantic verifier re-reads local and remote Git state after the operation.
Exactly one owner_terminal event and one matching terminal artifact exist for effect_id.

mode_specific.dry-run: Repository identity, branch, remote, source HEAD, empty index, manifest paths, and worktree change hashes match the report; no Git mutation occurred.
mode_specific.integrate-remote-and-resume: The integrated effect-marked commit descends from the prepared remote head, preserves the authorized manifest-only delta, equals local and remote heads, and leaves no rebase/index state.
mode_specific.isolated-integrate-and-resume: The effect-marked isolated commit equals remote head, contains only the authorized manifest/overlay delta, and the source repository snapshot is byte-identical to preparation.
mode_specific.isolated-reconcile-and-resume: The effect-marked reconciled commit equals remote head, contains only the authorized scope, satisfies the approved three-way/overlay/ledger rules, regenerates the blocker view canonically, and leaves the source snapshot unchanged.
mode_specific.publish: The exact effect-marked local commit has the approved parent, message, metadata policy, and manifest-only delta; local HEAD and remote branch head equal that commit; the index is empty; unrelated paths retain their prepared state.
mode_specific.resume-push: The authorized effect commit remains local HEAD and equals remote branch head; no new local commit was created.

source_corrections: Replace free repository paths and remote names with trusted repository/remote registry keys and materialized manifest sets.
Require and atomically consume an exact publication-authorization receipt for every mutating mode; contract approval alone never authorizes publication.
Add a deterministic Prevention-Effect-ID commit trailer and journaled stage receipts so a crash after commit or push can be reconciled without duplication.
Split long integration modes into progressively reserved typed stages and terminalize only after local/remote/source semantic re-observation.
